description: Super-population label rule on the supervised-admixture proportions q: multinomial logistic regression on [q, sqrt(q), log(q_k/q_EUR) for k in AFR,AMR,EAS,SAS]; the label is the most probable class when its probability is >= tau, otherwise 'admixed'.

training.source: 1000 Genomes phase 3 GRCh38 reference individuals that are not benchmark test individuals (leave-out), q fitted from exact genotypes on a fixed random 300,000-site subset of the panel with leave-one-out super-population frequencies
training.tau_note: tau 0.8 is the existing q_min convention; the cross-validated choice on exact-genotype q (0.5) never abstains because those q are overconfident

ood_note: abstain when the L1 distance from q to the nearest reference individual exceeds ood_l1 (99.5th percentile of the leave-one-out nearest-neighbour distance among the reference individuals): the rule is not trusted away from where it was trained
